exposure: In utero HIV exposure status (HIV-exposed uninfected vs. HIV-unexposed)
cohort: The study included 59 newborns (35 HIV-exposed uninfected and 24 HIV-unexposed) participating in the FLOURISH observational study.
finding: Brain ultrasounds conducted by trained nurses are feasible and revealed a shorter corpus callosum length in HIV-exposed uninfected infants compared to HIV-unexposed infants.
